name: prologue
description: The pre-world tutorial: new souls spawn in The Inbetween and walk a one-way corridor (chargen at the MORPHEX terminal → first Architect Interface IP + tablet + holocaster at the holosign → an eerie welcome broadcast) before collapsing into the Coldwater clone vat, where the reinstatement machine issues the tablet (there is none in the corridor) and the bar offers its walkthrough. Move gates hard-gate the three narrative doors; the void rooms are lit by the engine's zones.flags.always_lit property. Also carries the one post-vat onboarding beat: after your first kill, Grady points you at his armchair to teach that sitting heals. And the one out-of-fiction beat: on a first login it asks whether the player has ever played a multiplayer text game, and if not the client runs a spotlight tour of the interface (tutorial replays it).
